generation_fact: One atomic relation established by a concrete execution: its exact source information, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role; it is not identified merely by values shared with another fact.
generation_occurrence: One concrete execution that may realize several distinct generation facts; the occurrence is linked to each fact but is not interchangeable with any of them.
atomic_generation_fact: The source, transformation, occurrence, outcome, and role remain one indivisible fact identity, so facts from an occurrence must be kept separate rather than decomposed and recombined.
realizes_fact: This primitive relation connects a generation occurrence to the exact generation fact it established.
reads_from: This primitive relation records an actual data dependency and must not be inferred from mere execution order, timestamps, or similar values.
GeneratedOrigin: This relation records that an outcome formed earlier participates as the source of a later generation fact.
program_order: This relation records declared execution order only; by itself it establishes neither a data dependency nor concurrency.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or equal outputs do not establish identical facts, occurrences, results, or formation histories.
cartesian_recombination: It is invalid to split the facts realized by an occurrence into source and result sets and reconstruct alleged facts by their Cartesian product; exact atomic incidences must be preserved.
missing_relations: An absent relation means it was not established in the graph and does not automatically prove its negation; in particular, a missing concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: Follow exact identities along training sample to batch occurrence to forward occurrence to loss to backward occurrence to gradient to optimizer occurrence to new parameter version, using primitive facts, realizes_fact, reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, and incidence relations rather than value or time similarity.
reverse_query: Start from the exact evaluation or parameter result and traverse backward through its actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, origin-incidence, and outcome-incidence relations; do not substitute timestamps or numeric similarity.
executable_claim: The sealed executable mechanism is the scientific authority; the report explains and cites it but cannot replace an executable state and update law that generate unseen continuous execution without reading the future.
state_sufficiency: At a cut, test whether equal or sufficiently similar proposed state and declared input produce compatible next state and outcome within tolerance; search the graph for divergent futures, omitted evolving variables, and transitions the update law cannot generate, enlarging or revising the state when a counterexample is found.
prefix_only_falsification: At multiple cuts before, near, and after candidate transitions, initialize using only each graph prefix, forecast a later interval without suffix access, compare to the recorded suffix, retain failures, and revise or reject the candidate; a full-run fit is not this test.
report_code_correspondence: Map every forecast-relevant report claim to exact primitive GFG evidence, an executable state field or justified elimination, and a concrete update-law expression; every executable field must be updated or be a prefix-derived frozen constant.
operational_state_use: Field presence, serialization, or reporting is not operational use: identify the exact expression by which each claimed controller can alter a required forecast, then perturb, remove, or hold it fixed in prefix-only replay and relabel ineffectual fields as diagnostics or revise the law.
intervention_state_audit: For an affected operation, enumerate every state read or written, determine what the hook changes, freezes, or leaves evolving, propagate all differences through the executable update law, and test on permitted discovery prefixes; pure time translation requires all necessary state to translate consistently.
cross_run_invariance: Separate structural laws, prefix-inferred state, discovery-estimated parameters, and uncertainty; falsify fixed clocks, rates, periods, amplitudes, and increments with multiple prefix cuts and matched-state divergent-future searches. Passing within-run tests only means not falsified there: correct state semantics do not establish a transportable law, which requires sealing and prospective testing on a distinct unseen continuous execution.
